## Affected Submodules
Which submodules of this repository would be involved in implementing this feature.

## Summary
A clear, concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem / Motivation
What problem does this solve? What's the use case? Why is this needed?

## Proposed Solution
Describe how you think this should work. Be as specific as possible.

## Alternatives Considered
Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds? Why is this approach preferred?

## Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, screenshots, or references that would help explain the feature.

## Checklist
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to make sure this hasn't already been suggested
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project's scope and goals
